messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Pantoprazole is not for the immediate relief of heartburn symptoms.
Heartburn is often confused with the first symptoms of a heart attack.
Seek emergency medical attention if you have chest pain or heavy feeling, pain spreading to the arm or shoulder, nausea, sweating, and a general ill feeling.
Long-term treatment with pantoprazole may make it harder for your body to absorb vitamin B-12.
This difficulty in absorption may result in a deficiency of vitamin B-12.
Talk with your doctor if you need long-term pantoprazole treatment and you have concerns about vitamin B-12 deficiency.
Pantoprazole can cause kidney problems.
Tell your doctor if you are urinating less than usual, or if you have blood in your urine.
Diarrhea may be a sign of a new infection.
Call your doctor if you have diarrhea that is watery or has blood in it.
Pantoprazole may cause new or worsening symptoms of lupus.
Tell your doctor if you have joint pain and a skin rash on your cheeks or arms that worsens in sunlight.
Triplet: ["Diarrhea", "may indicate", "new infection"]

The relation 'may indicate' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject entity can be a sign or symptom of the medical condition specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'related to': The subject entity is associated with or connected to the medical condition or entity specified by the object entity.
B. 'mimics symptoms of': The subject condition or symptom can resemble or be mistaken for the medical condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'has symptom': The condition specified by the subject entity is associated with the symptom specified by the object entity.
D. 'can lead to': The subject condition or event may result in the medical complication or outcome specified by the object entity.
E. 'occurs in': The subject medical condition is observed or experienced by the group of individuals specified by the object entity.
